facts.fact: AfriqueITNews reports the Congolese government entrusted Silicone Connect under a public-private partnership with upgrading the national fibre network between Pointe-Noire and Brazzaville to 200 Gb, a EUR 3.2 million project launched on 12 July 2024.
AfriqueITNews reports the first phase, the southern backbone, was completed, moving from SDH to DWDM on the existing Pointe-Noire to Brazzaville fibre network.

systems.owner: Government of Congo, PPP with Silicone Connect
